{{Wireless adapter |brand=Foxconn |model=T77H387 |revision=.00 |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=01/24/2014 |manuf_country=China |is_manuf=Yes |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |availability= |if=USB (non-standard connector) |if_bus_version=2.0 |if_connector_type= |form_factor=module |vendor_id= |device_id= |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |id_string= |fcc_id=N89-WU172HS |ic_id= |chip1_brand=Ralink |chip1_model=RT5372;RT5372L, TPNT026509, 1304STA1; |chip2_brand= |chip2_model= |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |chip4_brand= |chip4_model= |addl_chips= |accessible_UART=No |flags= |ant_conn= |802dot11_protocols=bgn |txchains=2 |rxchains=2 |sstreams=2 |oui=1C:3E:84, 54:35:30 |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} "REV.0 GP" and "T77H387.00" is silkscrened on the board in the FCC photos. :This device is filed under a '''CyberTAN''' grantee code (seems to be model WU172HS) and is marked with '''Hon Hai''' / '''Foxconn''' P/Ns as well as a '''Hon Hai''' MAC (1C:3E:84 OUI). '''CyberTAN''' is, however, a member of the '''Foxconn Group'''.
The FCC sample label notes this module as having '''[[wikipedia:Hisense|Hisense]]''' P/N 1127000. It may be used in one of their products (refrigerator, A/C unit, probably some other stuff).
The 1C:3E:84 OUI is assumed to be used by at least some of these devices.
